producer_contract_review.checkpoint: Training producer keeps only a strictly higher-mAP best and reloads it. audit_full_official49 reads exactly epochs1..50, uses Python max with earliest ties, and verifies selected metrics. Diagnostic producer and state audit enforce selected epoch plus exact full11 distances and per-query parity; analyzer compares all six exported state metrics with those saved installed-GT audits.
producer_contract_review.sampling: Analyzer compares epoch/step/names/partial_set across all six trial runs and compares their epoch/step/names against both completed full-protocol MSVR baselines. producer_contract_review.capacity: All three variants must match total/trainable parameters and5632D within each mode; each M3b total/trainable count must exceed matching M3a by exactly27769.

producer_contract_review.costs: Analyzer reports selected-checkpoint normal extraction runtime, seven frozen-availability extraction runtimes and peak training allocated memory. The producer's trained.runtime is inference extraction time, not total training wall time; no total training wall-time conclusion was inferred.
producer_contract_review.transfer: Remote archive allowlist is only .json/.csv/.jsonl/.log within the owned run root. No weight, NPZ, dataset or credential file transfer is requested. Existing archive and local destination must be absent.
producer_contract_review.caveats: goal_complete remains false; benchmark checkpoint selection, repeated-query/overlapping group means, single dataset/seed, inference closure vs retraining and empirical noncausal margin limitations remain explicit.
